title: Add NVTX ranges, microbench harness, and runtime perf dashboard
author: Asha Kumar
commits: add: NVTX scope helper and macros (runtime/profiling)
instrument: NVTX ranges in attention, KV cache load/store, continuous batcher paths
add: microbench harness + attention/kv benchmarks + CI job
add: Grafana dashboard JSON + perf collection script
fix: build flags for NVTX optional dependency, add unit tests for microbench runner
description: Context: Performance workstreams require fine-grained runtime visibility to validate kernel & scheduler changes. Motivation: Add NVTX ranges and lightweight microbench harness to capture per-stage timing (attention, kv-cache load, kv-cache store, batch scheduling, kernel launch overhead) and wire up a Grafana dashboard for easy regression tracking. Changes: 1) Introduced runtime/profiling/nvtx_scopes.h providing NVTX_SCOPE/ NVTX_RANGE macros and RAII helpers; NVTX is optional at build-time with fallback no-ops. 2) Instrumented attention kernels, kv_cache load/store paths, and continuous_batcher hot paths with NVTX ranges and counters. 3) Added microbench harness (tools/microbench) with deterministic inputs, per-iteration warmup, and CSV output. 4) Added a perf collector and dashboard JSON to tools/perf for automatic ingestion into our Grafana instance. 5) CI: new microbench workflow runs on push to main nightly and for PRs tagged perf. Validation: run tools/microbench/microbench_runner.py --profile attention --itrs 100; collected metrics match expected baseline within 10% and produce CSV. Notes: NVTX instrumentation is gated behind BUILD_NVTX cmake flag; no behavior changes when off. This is purely observability and does not change kernel algorithms. Checklist: - [x] NVTX helper API added - [x] Instrumented key runtime paths - [x] Microbench runner + tests - [x] Grafana dashboard JSON + sample data - [x] CI workflow for microbench
review_comments: Evan Li: Please ensure NVTX ranges are cheap in hot paths; recommend RAII helper and short name tags only.
Asha Kumar: Addressed in second commit; RAII helper added and tag strings shortened to 16 chars.
Priya Nair: Can we add counters for KV cache hits vs misses so we can correlate perf regressions?
Asha Kumar: Added lightweight atomic counters exported via /metrics in runtime/profiling; documented in instrumentation.md.
Tom Hsu: Microbench CI flaked on first run due to missing CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES in runner container. Fixed by explicitly setting device in CI job.
Evan Li: Approved after NVTX no-op fallback and CI fixes verified.
release_notes: Added NVTX-based runtime instrumentation and a microbenchmark harness to track kernel/scheduler/kv-cache performance; includes Grafana dashboard for regression hunting and CI microbench job; instrumentation is opt-in via BUILD_NVTX flag.
notes_for_ops: Enable BUILD_NVTX when building runtime images used for perf testing. The NVTX symbols are optional and cause no runtime overhead when disabled. The microbench CI job requires a GPU runner and CUDA drivers; see .github/workflows/microbench.yml for details.
